title: Undergraduate Thesis II
description: Continuation of a research project conducted under the direction of a faculty member.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of MLSC 499B, BCMB 499A, BCMB 499B, BIOC 499, BIOC 499A, BIOC 499B, MICR 499, MICR 499A, MICR 499B.
